name: Old Man
source: The old man who came into the store [url=/c167374]Kenpachi[/url] was working at before the attack of Metal Mage on the city. Afterward, he bought that very store and started working there. [spoiler]Later, he turned out to be the career villain (supervillain) "Harsh-light," as well as Kenpachi's grandfather.[/spoiler]
